people.name: Asa
people.line: King of Judah, son of Abijah; father of Jehoshaphat

people.name: Baasha
people.line: Third king of Israel who ruled for 24 years.

people.name: Elah
people.line: Son of Baasha, king of Israel

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Tirzah
people.line: Canaanite city that became the capital of Israel

translations.web: In the twenty-sixth year of Asa king of Judah, Elah the son of Baasha began to reign over Israel in Tirzah for two years.
translations.bsb: In the twenty-sixth year of Asa’s reign over Judah, Elah son of Baasha became king of Israel, and he reigned in Tirzah two years.
translations.kjv: In the twenty and sixth year of Asa king of Judah began Elah the son of Baasha to reign over Israel in Tirzah, two years.
translations.asv: In the twenty and sixth year of Asa king of Judah began Elah the son of Baasha to reign over Israel in Tirzah, and reigned two years.
